notes: Committee negotiation beat. Fires when the player's bill stalls in committee. Speaker: Helen Donovan (Committee Chair) — Old Guard Survivor archetype. Purpose: introduce the quid-pro-quo scheduling dynamic; the Chair wants a floor favour in exchange for scheduling the player's bill. Two choice points: (1) how the player reads the Chair's framing — diplomatic / direct / challenge (Integrity ≥ 4 gate, subtext-naming); (2) strategic response to the explicit ask — accept the deal, resist it (Connections ≥ 5 gate), or defer. Branch-specific flags (committee-chair-debt, committee-chair-refused, committee-chair-pending) are observable by downstream committee and scheduling events. No faction effects authored — OQ-1 (faction-standing kind) unresolved per intro-aide-dialogue-notes.md. 'helen-donovan' is a new character not in GDD §12.3.4 named seed list — TODO(vex): Jesse to create wiki entry. 'senator-harlow' is a named placeholder referenced in path-accept — TODO(vex): confirm whether Harlow needs a full NPC entry or can remain a name-drop. See intro-aide-dialogue-notes.md Content wave 3 for open questions.

open.speaker: helen-donovan
open.text: Senator. Sit. I don't have long, and I'd rather not waste what I have.

background.speaker: helen-donovan
background.text: Your bill has been in this committee eleven days. I've read it. My staff has read it. We have notes.

options.label: I imagine some of those notes are actionable.
Tell me what the problems are. I'll address them.
Your staff has been quiet publicly. This was always going to be a different conversation.
options.failureHint: Requires Integrity 4. You haven't earned the standing to name what's happening in this room.

read-diplomatic.speaker: helen-donovan
read-diplomatic.text: That's a useful word. Actionable. We'll see if your definition and mine are similar.

read-direct.speaker: helen-donovan
read-direct.text: The bill is technically sound. The problem is what scheduling it signals. That's not a technical problem.

read-challenge.speaker: helen-donovan
read-challenge.text: Eleven days here and you're reading committee politics. Someone talked to you. Good for them.

leverage.speaker: helen-donovan
leverage.text: I have something in front of your bill that needs a friend on the floor. You find me one, I find you a date.

options.label: Tell me who you need. I'll make the call.
I'm not in the brokering business. The bill stands on its merits.
options.failureHint: Requires Connections 5. You don't have the standing to walk away from this room yet.

options.label: Give me forty-eight hours to look at the landscape.

path-accept.speaker: helen-donovan
path-accept.text: Senator Harlow. Tell him it's a courtesy from my office. He won't need the details.

path-resist.speaker: helen-donovan
path-resist.text: Then we have nothing to discuss today. The bill stays where it is until the calendar has room.

path-defer.speaker: helen-donovan
path-defer.text: Forty-eight hours is a weekend. Come back Monday with an answer, not a question.

exit.speaker: narrator
exit.text: The Chair's assistant is already at the door before the conversation ends.
